card.name: Linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, and, with, or a colon that come right before a second drug name is about to be written. Seen in dosing and drug-interaction lists, often before a name starting with a hard sound such as c, h, or p.

modes.label: of before a drug
modes.description: The word of after a dose amount or drop, just before the drug name.
modes.example: one drop<< of>> pilocarpine hydrochloride o

modes.label: and/with joining drugs
modes.description: The word and or with linking two drugs or therapies in a combination.
modes.example: in combination with paclitaxel<< and>> topotecan. 2.7

modes.label: colon before examples
modes.description: A colon after a drug class, before example drug names.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts like vert or e, and away from che-type pieces, so it has no clear drug-name effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before a drug name is named, like the 'of' in 'one drop of'.
